report.headline: Mechanism FOUND, fix NOT: the tracking-made DAC zeros are driven by the HEADING CHANNEL (heading:=path tangent rescues 56.9 % [45.1, 66.0] of the 144 navtest tracker-made zeros; dev replicates 53.8 % [44.8, 69.8] on 1,172 fan units) with actuator/steering lag second (47.2 % [38.5, 57.3]). But NO admissible fix clears the dev bar: F_c -0.30 [-0.72, +0.04] PDMS, F_b -0.03 [-0.15, +0.07], F_bc -0.19 [-0.68, +0.27], F_m +0.00 [-0.06, +0.05]; even the inadmissible pre-compensation ceiling reads -0.19 [-0.76, +0.63]. Why: at the PICK the tracker SAVES about as many plans as it breaks (dev N-s0 tracker-saved 27 vs tracker-made 20; navtest ~132 ESTIMATED vs 144), so ZT3's 1.07 PDMS was GROSS reach; net reach of execution-side levers is ~0. No navtest confirm is issued (PREREG section 6).
report.status_rule_zero: Every remaining lever is BLOCKED or closed: execution side (F_c, F_a) and map-free selection (F_b, F_bc, F_m) measured ~0 or negative on dev; the zero tail is a boundary-MARGIN problem whose lever is the scorer's boundary representation = ZT3's committed next experiment ZT4 (P6 trunk DAC gradient), BLOCKED on the P6 checkpoint (queued, authorised; control arm already measured in ZT4_BASELINE.json). Training-side margin targets (P5 arm (i)/P5-C) need the PI's GPU go.

Tracking fidelity improves on dev (delta -0.038 [-0.075, -0.011] m, heading MAE -0.16 [-0.24, -0.08] deg) but the footprint rotation breaks near-boundary plans. Pre-compensation draws a path off the intended one (drawn footprint fails +11.1 pp on dev): a real car with another controller would drive it.
